_preregistration.why: #100 returned null at z=1.49 with a CONTAMINATED statistic -- two candidates inside their own 8-point reference. 24 singles give a real reference distribution
_preregistration.primary: is any layer's selectivity an outlier at |z| >= 2, computed LEAVE-ONE-OUT?
_preregistration.secondary: is selectivity monotone in depth? #100 saw early > mid > late with late NEGATIVE; a depth profile cannot be manufactured by one noisy layer
_preregistration.null: no outlier and no depth trend -> lambda_ca is not carried by any localisable part of the attention stack and #100's pattern was noise. A NULL IS A GOOD RESULT
_preregistration.kill: most runs unignited -> lambda undefined (F42) -> NOT DECIDABLE, checked per layer
_preregistration.control: `none` re-measured in-file, re-validating the harness against F77's +0.3566
_preregistration.boundary: a layer is a COMPONENT not a mechanism; naming the circuit needs #69/#70
_preregistration.declared_by: #100's own text: 'singles are the follow-up if a group separates'

verdict: NULL, AND IT IS A CLEAN ONE: NO single attention layer moves lambda_ca outside its own seed scatter. The largest single-layer effect is L16 at |d_lambda|=0.0577 against a seed sd of 0.0611; 0 of 24 clear 2 sigma. Yet removing EIGHT layers together gives d_lambda=+0.345 and all 24 gives +0.342, while the 24 singles SUM to -0.224 -- the wrong sign. The effect is STRONGLY NON-ADDITIVE: it is not localised in any layer and not diffusely spread either, or the singles would sum toward the group value. Ignition says the same: 8/8 on every single layer against 7/8 and 6/8 for the groups. lambda_ca is not attributable to a localisable component, which is the pre-registered null for the explanandum programme. Denominator diagnostic: Spearman(d_loss, |per_nat|) = -0.472 (p=0.02), so any ratio-based ranking here would have been driven by its denominator.

_note: #100 follow-up, declared in #100's own text ('singles are the follow-up if a group separates'). 24 single-layer attention ablations give a real reference distribution, fixing the contamination that made #100 read null: selectivity was z-scored against a set containing its own two candidates. z is leave-one-out here. Everything -- the ablation harness, the loss measurement, and dev_transition_phase3.measure -- is imported, so there is one implementation of each. A null closes the explanandum programme for real.
